event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: A detailed review of the supplied 2024-12-17 KEYS (Keysight) 10-K excerpt reveals no explicit references to the COVID-19 pandemic, global pandemics in general, or any of the typical derivative themes (e.g., emergency public-health measures, lockdown-related supply-chain interruptions, large-scale remote-work transitions). The risk factor discussion instead focuses on inflation, recession fears, geopolitical conflicts, trade restrictions, climate-related weather volatility, energy costs, and other macro conditions. Because no sentence directly or indirectly attributes operational, financial, or strategic risk to COVID-19 or any other pandemic, there is no evidence to score. Under the methodology, the absence of relevant disclosure means the risk is effectively un-signaled in this document; therefore, all pandemic-related risk indicators default to a base severity of zero.
